study_identification_part.si_4_title: Dissimilarity in Sulcal Width Patterns in the Cortex can be Used to Identify Patients With Schizophrenia With Extreme Deficits in Cognitive Performance

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Participants were selected from two longitudinal cohorts: the Utrecht Schizophrenia project and the Genetic Risk and Outcome of Psychosis (GROUP) consortium.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Participants for the current study were selected from a large longitudinal sample based on two cohorts including patients with schizophrenia and healthy controls, the Utrecht Schizophrenia project and the Genetic Risk and Outcome of Psychosis (GROUP) consortium, in Utrecht, the Netherlands.

answer.Utrecht: normative training/testing; patient for clinical research

answer.GROUP: normative training/testing; patient for clinical research

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy controls from both the Utrecht and GROUP cohorts were used to create a normative reference (PBSI-SW and PBSI-CT), and patients from both cohorts were compared against this norm to identify outliers and evaluate clinical/cognitive associations.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: From a large longitudinal sample of patients with schizophrenia and healthy participants... we included individuals who had T1-weighted MRI scan acquisitions at 2 time points. ... we created a normative reference for PBSI-SW by calculating the average... and standard deviation... for the healthy control subjects (C)
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Janssen2021.pdf.md: Methods / Sample and Neuroimaging; Normative Modeling

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The normative model (PBSI-SW) and the comparison model (PBSI-CT) were developed using a sample of 164 healthy participants, each with scans at two time points. The whole HC group was used to define the normative reference at each time point.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: The final data set consisted of 656 scans from 164 healthy participants and 164 patients.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age stats provided are for healthy controls at baseline. The age range 16-70 is specified in the methods section for the Utrecht sample and reflects the overall sample range at baseline.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The healthy control group (N=164) included 126 males (77% as reported in Table 1). Female counts and calculated percentages (38, 23.2%) were inferred from these values.
